critical_code_review_comments: Endpoint correctly parallelises hero + gallery fetches via asyncio.gather (products_master_specs.py:668-671) so wall time ≈ max(hero, gallery) not sum — good.
Cache key `detail::{brand}::{norm}` is namespaced separately from `/91mobiles-specs` cache — no collision risk. TTL 30 days same as specs.
Response omits spec_tabs by design (fast-path); frontend must not depend on that key here — confirmed shape difference vs /91mobiles-specs.
Gallery correctly capped at 12 (verified live: iPhone 15 returned exactly 12 -1024w2 images).

502 branch (`raise HTTPException(status_code=502, detail='GSMArena returned no images')` at line 674) not triggered in tests since every real match returns images — acceptable coverage: fallback path only fires on GSMArena outage.
